opinions.text: C. A. 3d Cir. [Certiorari granted, 450 U. S. 909.] Motion of the Solicitor General for divided argument and for additional time for oral argument granted, and 10 additional minutes allotted for that purpose. Respondent Americans United for Separation of Church and State also allotted an additional 10 minutes for oral argument.
